method.input: OMF library LEDATA bytes from segments whose SEGDEF name or class is CODE/_TEXT/TEXT
method.match: Exact 32-byte windows, sampled every 4 bytes, at least 12 distinct byte values and Shannon entropy >=3.2 bits/byte; exact contiguous extension around each hit
method.image_scope: Headerless, unrelocated load image only; excludes the MZ header and applied relocations
limitations: Exact runtime byte evidence only; it does not identify the game's compiler or compiler version.
Only library-owned code regions are searched; fixup bytes can break exact runs.
Libraries are read in place and are neither copied nor included in output.
A matching member may be common runtime code or coincidental; review context before attribution.
